caption: The drawing depicts a single female figure centered on a plain, light-colored background. She is shown standing on her left foot, with her right leg raised and bent, crossing in front of her left leg. Both of her arms are raised, with the left arm extended upwards in a soft curve above her head and the right arm bent at the elbow, hanging in front of her. She has long, wavy hair that falls over her shoulders and down her back. The figure is wearing a short, puffed skirt in shades of reddish-pink and orange, along with a fitted bodice that is greenish-blue with detailing at the edges and neckline. The sleeves are short, and there is visible shading and textural detailing on the costume to suggest folds and fabric. Her feet are bare, with an anklet visible on her left ankle. The overall composition shows the figure alone and against the neutral background, with no other objects or scenery present. The coloring uses a combination of muted pastels, including flesh tones for the skin, along with greenish, blue, orange, and pinkish hues for the clothing and hair.
title: Dancing Girl from Spark's Carousel Wagon
